description_en: Queries information about an asynchronous task
description_zh: 调用GetTask查询异步任务信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso get-task --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --task-id t-shfqw1u1edszvxw50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTask

AccessConfigurationId.description_en: The ID of the access configuration

AccessConfigurationName.description_en: The name of the access configuration

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the task
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

FailureReason.description_en:
The cause of the task failure.

This parameter is returned only when the value of `Status` is `Failed`
FailureReason.description_zh:
任务失败原因。

只有`Status`为`Failed`，才会显示该参数

PrincipalId.description_en: The ID of the CloudSSO identity

PrincipalName.description_en: The name of the CloudSSO identity

PrincipalType.description_en:
The type of the CloudSSO identity. Valid values:

User
Group
PrincipalType.description_zh:
云SSO身份类型。取值：

User：用户。
Group：用户组

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the task
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间。格式为 RFC 3339 的 UTC 时间（YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

InProgress: The task is running.
Success: The task is successful.
Failed: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

InProgress：任务执行中。
Success：任务执行成功。
Failed：任务执行失败

TargetId.description_en: The ID of the task object

TargetName.description_en: The name of the task object

TargetPath.description_en: The path ID of the task object in the resource directory
TargetPath.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径ID

TargetPathName.description_en: The path name of the task object in the resource directory
TargetPathName.description_zh: 任务目标在资源目录中的路径名称

TargetType.description_en: The type of the task object. The value is fixed as RD-Account, which indicates the accounts in the resource directory
TargetType.description_zh: 任务目标类型。取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:

ProvisionAccessConfiguration: An access configuration is provisioned.
DeprovisionAccessConfiguration: An access configuration is de-provisioned.
CreateAccessAssignment: Access permissions on an account in the resource directory are assigned.
DeleteAccessAssignment: Access permissions on an account in the resource directory are removed
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型。取值：

ProvisionAccessConfiguration：部署访问配置。
DeprovisionAccessConfiguration：解除访问配置部署。
CreateAccessAssignment：在RD账号上授权。
DeleteAccessAssignment：移除RD账号上的授权
